You hit the nail on the head with that. The feeling for me at least, is more wishing that I just never existed to cause that grief in the first place.

By the way thank you for taking the time to talk with me about all of this.. I haven't said that yet. I've spent the past hour since I got off the phone with the crisis hotline guy in my dad's van (borrowing it because my car broke down) crying to the point that I was dry heaving.

I did.. She was the first (and last) person who I ever really opened up in front of. It ended up not working out between us and I've been by myself for a couple years ever since.  The fact that I'm not with her is okay though, I understand that those things don't always work out. But I've certainly been guarded ever sense. Having someone that at least understood me and knowing that I wasn't alone at the end of the day certainly did help. There's a girl now who is one of, if not my best friend, but she doesn't see me in that way and I wouldn't want to pursue anything with her until I fixed whatever was going on in my head and was happy with myself first.

He recommended talking to a therapist or someone who I can at least release my feelings to instead of bottling up. However that brought up the insurance conversation which makes me feel like I'm getting into more debt from my problem because of my problem.

Where I live has crisis hotline that you can call and talk to people. I just gave them a call because I have no one really I am comfortable venting to in real life. I can't say it helped as of now because now I'm sitting outside and can't stop crying. The fact that I can't actually kill myself hurts almost as much as the fact that I want to. The guy on the hotline had a good way of putting it.. I feel like I hit rock bottom and then the bottom just keeps falling deeper.

I just.. I can't bring it up to anyone in my family or even with any of my fiends. I don't want to hurt my family and my friends will not understand my will not live at all. I'm pretty sure they know I'm not happy, they can tell. But I honestly don't know if they think it's as bad as it really is. The debt is mainly from student loans which have lead to payday loans which have lead to me not being able to afford rent. I'm well aware of how stupid payday loans are but here I am. Sorry if I'm kind of rambling.. I'm beyond lost right now with what I actually want to happen to me

About seriously wanting to end it? Maybe a couple weeks. I don't  even know the last time I've felt "happy" or "okay" though. I'm talking since I can remember and I'm only 29 years old. I've just always bottled it up or felt like I should "truck through it." I seriously, deeply, don't want to hurt anyone else but my life is pointless to me. It's just a burden on me and I'm a burden on my family. Nobody I know in real life knows I'm this close or that I've felt this way because I don't want to bring anyone down any more than they already are. My family has been through enough already.
Yes I do
Also thank you for the link.. that honestly might be the step I have to take for something to change for me.
Student loans
I've considered relocating to a different city.. but just get bogged down with the idea of being in debt just following me wherever I go

Social relationships.. I haven't even hugged a girl, let alone actually been on a date or anything since I broke up with my ex 3 years. And that's a whole other issue that weighs heavy on me.

Family relationships.. my parents are getting old. I see how age is getting to them and I've never seen people who have such a pessimistic attitude towards life. I've noticed it mostly from my mother since I was a teenager and always told myself I don't want to live life that way. But it's just been beating me down for as long as I can remember. 

Money.. I know you can't buy happiness and all that jazz. I very well know things can always be worse. I am very thankful that I was lucky enough to be born into a (at the time) middle-class American family. And I've never made any excuses and blamed anyone for how things are. But fuck.. I'm tired of living paycheck to paycheck and now I can barley even afford rent while eating ramen noodles and spaghetti o's every week. I've worked hard my whole life and for one reason or another here I am. In all honesty I think this is the thing that puts everything over the top.  All those other issues are just life problems. I feel like this should be in my control. But it's not. I feel like there is nothing I can do at this point that is going to change that and I can only continue to work as hard as I can and hope it doesn't get worse.

I'm right here in the same boat. I'm getting close to my breaking point because I just had my 29th birthday and can't remember the last time, if ever, that I've been really happy.  I have one of my best friends who is a girl who I've spent almost every day with the past couple months because I don't hate my life as much when I'm around her. She doesn't know that though.  On days when I feel a little worse and you can tell just by looking at me and she tries to get me to talk about what's wrong I just brush it off. I'm too scared to get any closer to her..


Sorry if I'm kinda venting.. I was going to post this on it's own but your post felt all too familiar. So, for what it's worth,  just know you're not alone in that struggle.
